title: The Hill
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-17 from story_script_v1 §7 (4.2: reach Ambedkar Nagar; owner aunty gone; room ransacked; guitar, induction, bed = first base; the barter table replaces UPI; the crafting bench = the kitchen table that didn't fit [P]), act4 doc §1 (Suresh = the hill landlord, owner aunty's husband, the base's protector; Deepa a hill neighbour; Karthik a neighbour, the evacuate voice), §7 (the four recipes), chapter_board_merge §B2 (4b: UPI dies), Act 4 systems plan v1 (approved 'default', 2026-10-17) §3.6–3.9 (harsh survival, barter as negotiation, base stock, generator + UV, sleep only in a base) and §8 Q3 (UPI dies for good here), Q6 (the cast at the hill), Q7 (barter values), landmarks doc §3.1 (reveals #20–22). Needs S3 (the base) before it can be built. S3 (ADR-149): the first trade follows the barter values — laptop → a food packet (haggled: + cloth), not a power bank + two packets.
time: Act 4 day 0, 21:30 → the morning of day 1
player_goal: Get up the hill to the flat, and make it somewhere you can survive the night.
design_goal: The housing ladder pays off: the room you signed for in 1.4, furnished in 2.4, becomes the first base. Money dies on screen (UPI's last 'Server busy' becomes 'This service is no longer available'), and a different economy starts at a neighbour's table. Every object the player bought in Acts 1–2 gets a second use: the table is a bench, the guitar a lure and a comfort, the scooter's fuel feeds a generator. Progress + Reward after 4.1's Tense (ADR-24).

cast.role: NEW. Suresh, 50s, owner aunty's husband, the landlord (he was at their daughter's in Mysuru until the curfew). Strict, frightened, kind underneath. Has kept the colony's diesel generator and one UV lamp running on the terrace. On aunty: 'She went to the temple on Tuesday.' Nothing more. Gives you the first water and rice, and a rule: 'No noise after five. No lights facing the road.'

Manju the broker (1.4) is now a trader at a folding table on the terrace: the barter table. Takes things, not money: 'Your phone is a brick now, boss. What else have you got?' Haggles like the negotiation mini-game, in item value.
Leela (existing neighbour) stays behind her grille; trades a candle for the news you bring; tells you Deepa from the end flat 'hasn't come home since the lab'.
NEW. Karthik, 20s, the startup-dreamer neighbour, already packing: 'The army's evacuating from Vidhana Soudha. We should go.' The evacuate voice (endings, 4.6).
Mani's chai stall is shut and chained; Mani himself sits behind it on a crate, and tells you which lanes are quiet. (He stays Mani — see the Raju question.)

beats.what: 21:30, the foot of the hill in the dark: the terraces silent, one purple light at the top (the UV lamp on the terrace). Two figures standing still in the lower lane facing a wall; you have to crouch past (S2: crouch + noise). The first use of crouch, again without text — the purple light is the goal.

The flat: the door forced, the room ransacked — drawers out, the mattress slit, the fridge open and empty. What's still there: the bed, the induction stove, the guitar (if bought) behind the door, and the kitchen table that didn't fit, still folded against the wall. Owner aunty's slippers outside her door; her door locked.

Suresh on the terrace with the generator and the UV lamp: who he is, aunty ('She went to the temple on Tuesday'), the rules (no noise after five, no lights to the road). He explains the lamp in one line: 'They don't come into the purple. The BBMP put them up at the camps.' He gives water + rice (base stock starts: food 2, water 2, fuel 1) and asks for fuel: your scooter's petrol is the generator's now (the fuel counter).

UPI dies: the phone's UPI app now says 'This service is no longer available.' (the last money moment; the wallet shows its number in grey). Manju at his folding table: the barter table opens (negotiation in item value; plan Q7 values). First trade suggested: your laptop for a food packet (haggled: + a cloth) — the plan's barter values (ADR-149).

Base setup: unfold the kitchen table → the crafting bench (the four recipes appear, the first one craftable with what's in the flat: a bandage from the torn bedsheet + water); the bed = the only place you can sleep in Act 4; the stock shelf shows food / water / fuel. Sleep: the night uses 1 of each; the generator hums; the morning is Act 4 day 1.
